summary: Updates clamped car-part visibility slider targets based on a mode selector at this+0x1AC8. Mode 1 slides the primary part groups toward hidden (integer targets 0, float targets 1028443341), mode 2 slides them toward visible (integer targets 1, float targets 1056964608); the mode-2 branch also applies FloatClamp to the second float target slot. A non-zero mode additionally drives six secondary part-group targets toward 1 (clamped), then runs a helper sequence: three ArithmeticComparison_20d0(2) calls, three ShortComputation_3060(dword_5EC3D0)-1 derived ArithmeticComparison_20d0 calls, and a final ArithmeticComparison_20d0(23).

Shared path: clamp the second float slider target 0x236C via FloatClamp against float min 0x2374 and float max 0x2378 (the mode-dependent write to 0x236C is then re-clamped).
Post-switch guard on mode selector at this+0x1AC8 being non-zero; a non-zero selector drives the secondary part-group targets and helper sequence.

Return the mode selector value at this+0x1AC8 as the function result.
